blocks.text: Condo buildings in Burnaby Hospital
Streets, schools and getting around Burnaby Hospital

items.t: "Burnaby Hospital" is the GVR board sub-area name used in the SnapStats GVR report for Burnaby — it is named for the hospital, not for a City neighbourhood plan. The sub-area is the residential area around Burnaby Hospital in central Burnaby, south of Canada Way and west of Deer Lake, with the hospital campus at 3935 Kincaid St. The City publishes no street-by-street written boundary for the MLS sub-area; exact MLS boundary streets are UNVERIFIED. Nearby areas: Sperling-Duthie and Deer Lake to the east, Burnaby Lake to the north-east across Canada Way, Cascade Heights to the south, Forest Glen and Metrotown to the west and south-west.

Where the condo stock concentrates: it barely does. Burnaby's tower and low-rise condo stock concentrates in its town centres (Metrotown to the south-west is this area's main shopping and condo centre), not around the hospital.

SnapStats publishes medians at community level only: Burnaby-wide Condos & Townhomes median was $686,000, $763/sqft, 98% sale-to-list, 36 days on market in September 2026 (August 2026 comparison: $650,000, $743/sqft, 95%, 32 days). There is no Burnaby Hospital sub-area median.

Main streets: Canada Way is the main east–west road at the area's north edge, Kincaid Street serves the hospital campus, and Deer Lake Parkway and Sperling Avenue link east to Deer Lake and City Hall (4949 Canada Way).

Transit: there is no SkyTrain station inside the sub-area; buses operate on Kincaid Street at the campus, and the nearest Millennium Line station is Sperling–Burnaby Lake Station at Sperling Avenue and Lougheed Highway, north-east across the Deer Lake / Burnaby Lake side (station walking distance for a specific address: UNVERIFIED).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Burnaby Hospital

items.t: Burnaby tax timing: City of Burnaby 2026 property taxes were due Friday, July 3, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to outstanding current taxes (and to an unclaimed home owner grant) after the July due date, with a further 5% after the September due date.

blocks.text: Good to know about Burnaby Hospital

items.t: The sub-area is a hospital with houses around it, not a condo district.

The hospital plan was renewed on a specific date. On September 21, 2026 the Province announced $210 million for the emergency department and surgical unit to proceed immediately, with expanded cancer care and a new acute-care tower to follow, building on the March 2026 opening of the new six-storey pavilion — construction on Kincaid Street is a multi-year condition of living beside the campus, not a one-season project.

The one strata complex carries two build years. The building directory dates 3980 Canada Way to 1984; a unit listing in the same complex says 1986. Neither source is a strata-plan record — a buyer ordering documents should expect the strata plan registration, not either published year, to govern.

Deer Lake's boardwalk is mid-replacement. The section of Deer Lake boardwalk by the boat launch, immediately east of the sub-area, closed September 21, 2026 for a full replacement, with completion scheduled by winter 2027 and a signed detour via Sperling Avenue and Deer Lake Drive.

The governing plans are both new. The Burnaby 2050 OCP was adopted December 9, 2025 and takes precedence over older community-plan maps, the Cascade Heights Community Plan at the sub-area's south side was adopted in March 2025, and Zoning Bylaw 2026 took effect July 1, 2026 — listing copy or advice citing the 1998 OCP or the old zoning bylaw is two documents out of date.

City Hall is the east-edge neighbour. Burnaby City Hall sits at 4949 Canada Way just east of the sub-area at Deer Lake, and Deer Lake Park (6450 Deer Lake Ave) — with the Burnaby Art Gallery, Shadbolt Centre for the Arts, Burnaby Village Museum and Hart House — is the cultural centre the townhouse stock markets itself against.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Burnaby Hospital

items.t: Form B diligence (the 1 strata complex above): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. For a 1980s wood-frame townhouse strata, the depreciation report and Form B are the central diligence documents — envelope, roof and plumbing cycles sit in them, not in listing copy.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Burnaby Hospital?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby Hospital. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Burnaby Hospital a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Burnaby Hospital had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Burnaby Hospital from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 condos and townhomes sold in Burnaby Hospital over those 4 months, out of 750 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Are there any apartment condos in the Burnaby Hospital sub-area?
faq.a: A buyer who needs an apartment is in practice shopping Metrotown or Brentwood and commuting to the campus.

faq.q: What is the strata stock that does exist here?
faq.a: One verified complex: the townhouses at 3980 Canada Way — 3 levels, freehold strata, frame-wood construction, with an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and gym on a grounds listing describes as a 13-acre oasis. The directory dates it 1984 and a unit listing dates it 1986; the conflict is unresolved, and the complex's published name, unit count and restrictions are UNCONFIRMED.

faq.q: How quiet is the attached market, in numbers?
faq.a: Burnaby-wide, the Condos & Townhomes median that month was $686,000 at $763/sqft with 36 days on market — community figures only; SnapStats publishes no sub-area median.

faq.q: Can I rent out a unit at 3980 Canada Way?
faq.a: For a long-term tenancy, the provincial rule governs: strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022. The complex's own published rental position is UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked — read the Form B and registered bylaws; a short-term rental bylaw, if registered, can still bind.

faq.q: What does the hospital redevelopment mean for someone buying attached here?
faq.a: Fraser Health describes Burnaby Hospital (3935 Kincaid St) as one of the largest hospitals outside the City of Vancouver and a UBC-affiliated teaching hospital; Phase 1 delivered a six-storey pavilion with 83 beds, and on September 21, 2026 the Province announced a renewed plan with $210 million for an improved and expanded emergency department and surgical unit, with expanded cancer care and a new acute-care tower to follow. That is long-term employment demand beside the sub-area — and years of construction on and around Kincaid Street, including past single-lane alternating traffic and a relocated bus stop at Kincaid and MacDonald Ave.

faq.q: Is there actually a townhouse complex in the Burnaby Hospital sub-area?
faq.a: One verified: the townhouses at 3980 Canada Way — 3 levels, freehold strata, frame-wood construction, with an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and gym on grounds a listing describes as a 13-acre oasis. The directory dates it 1984 and a unit listing dates it 1986; the conflict is unresolved, and the complex's published name, unit count and restrictions are UNCONFIRMED.

faq.q: Are there any apartment condos here instead?
faq.a: A buyer who needs an apartment is in practice shopping Metrotown or Brentwood and commuting to the campus.

faq.q: How quiet is the attached market, in numbers?
faq.a: Burnaby-wide, the Condos & Townhomes median that month was $686,000 at $763/sqft with 36 days on market — community figures only, combined condos and townhomes; SnapStats publishes no sub-area median.
